title.en: Reuse the line along two axes

t.zh: 横向加权器只能看一条线。二维平均还需要另一条轴的邻居；自己的三点加权器已开放空间轴设置。你决定两次处理怎样连接，对比亮点的十字和矩形响应。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The line sees one axis. A 2D average also needs the other; your weighted-line part exposes an axis setting. Decide how to connect two passes by comparing cross and square impulse responses. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 连续两轴处理形成外积贡献，不等于两图相加。只有可分离核才能这样替代，边界也须一致。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Consecutive axis passes form outer-product contributions, not a sum of two images. Equivalence requires a separable kernel and matched borders. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 复用三点加权器，先沿一条轴处理，再沿另一条轴使用同一组权重。目标是二维外积权重，不是两张处理图相加。
brief.en: Reuse the weighted line along both axes using the same weights. Match the 2D outer-product rule, not the sum of two processed images.

naiveWhy.zh: 独立处理两轴后相加只覆盖十字形贡献；前后组合才会让角上的邻居参与。
naiveWhy.en: Adding independent passes gives cross-shaped support; serial passes include corner contributions.

hint.zh: 用单个亮点观察角上的贡献从哪里来。元件的空间轴设置只改变取样方向，不改权重。
hint.en: Use an impulse to inspect corner contributions. The axis setting changes sample direction, not weights.

desc.zh: 把同一组三点权重沿两轴先后应用，运行你的三点加权电路。
desc.en: Apply the same three weights consecutively along both axes using your weighted-line circuit.
